gaps.POST /v1/endpoint-device-groups: creates an endpoint device group whose rules only narrow its devices' on-device policy (audited)
gaps.GET /v1/endpoint-device-groups: lists endpoint device groups with their devices and narrowing rules
gaps.DELETE /v1/endpoint-device-groups/:group: deletes a device group with its memberships and rules, a relaxation (settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.POST /v1/endpoint-device-groups/:groupId: adds an enrolled device to a device group (audited)
gaps.DELETE /v1/endpoint-device-groups/:group: removes a device from a group, a relaxation (settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.POST /v1/endpoint-device-groups/:groupId: adds an ask or deny command, file or package rule to a device group (audited)
gaps.DELETE /v1/endpoint-device-groups/:group: removes a group's narrowing rule, a relaxation (settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.POST /v1/endpoint-command-exceptions: requests a time-limited exception relaxing one rule on one device, naming another admin as approver (audited)
gaps.GET /v1/endpoint-command-exceptions: lists per-device command-rule exceptions with their derived state and the lifecycle table
gaps.POST /v1/endpoint-command-exceptions/:ex: approves an exception by its terms digest (approval_decide step-up, plus settings_relax beyond 24 hours; audited)
cancels the caller's own requested exception (audited)
revokes an active exception before its expiry (audited)
